description: This file manages the web UI for port forwarding settings on a network device. It includes logic for displaying current port forwarding rules, enabling/disabling port forwarding via a toggle, and handling user interactions such as adding, editing, or deleting rules. It also dynamically fetches current configuration values and updates the interface accordingly.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches a string value from the device configuration parameter.

methods.name: DmExtGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a given device data model section.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches multiple parameter values for specified device data model paths.
